title: Saudi Arabia's Basic Law names the Qur'an and the Prophet's Sunnah as the constitution
summary: Saudi Arabia's Basic Law names the Qur'an and the Prophet's Sunnah as the constitution.
body: Article 1 of the Basic Law, in the English compilation, states the kingdom's religion as Islam and its constitution as the Holy Qur'an and the Prophet's Sunnah. The source says: "Official religion Religion: Islam Status of religious law Constitution: The Holy Qur'an and the Prophet's Sunnah (traditions) Official or national languages Language: Arabic National capital Capital: Riyadh Article 2 Its national holidays: Eid Al-Fitr (a religious feast celebrated on the 1st of Shawal, the 10th month of the Islamic calendar) Eid Al-Ad-ha (a religious feast celebrated on the 10th of Dhul-Hijj ah, the 12th month of the Islamic calend" The Basic Law itself calls those sources the constitution. Article 7 then says the regime derives its power from them and that they rule over this and all other state laws.
